what_it_does: Harmonia solves the problem of running accelerators (Field Programmable Gate Arrays, or FPGAs) in cloud data centers where different servers have different hardware variants. Currently, cloud providers must write custom code for each FPGA model, while users must modify their applications for each variant, creating a fragmented ecosystem. Harmonia provides a unified abstraction layer that lets applications run on any FPGA variant without custom porting.
